correctness.rationale: The precise defining equation uv=θ(v)w and cut formula Cθ(w)={θ(v)u:w=uv} agree. Independently generated all 2^n binary words for each n=1,...,7 and both candidate conjugate constructions. Maxima by length are 2,2,2,2,2,2,3; the n=7 distribution is 46 words with 0, 52 with 1, 28 with 2, and 2 with 3. Both witnesses and six displayed palindromes match. This is a complete finite proof for n≤7 only, not an infinite upper bound on palindrome counts.
